breakdown.description: The prompt collapses the distributed self-weight into a single end load and calls it exact, even though the axial force from self-weight varies continuously along the bar.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification correctly uses the continuously varying axial force P(x) = 5.395 × (3500 - x) N and specifies integration δ = ∫₀ᴸ P(x)/(A E) dx to compute elongation. It does not mention replacing the distributed self-weight with a single concentrated end load, thereby eliminating the erroneous instruction present in the incomplete prompt and aligning with the ground truth approach.
